title: Research document
description: One research document of the corpus, kept for the stakeholder mining.

title.title: Title
title.description: A short name of at most 60 characters for the document, shortened from the title of the search hit or the name of the uploaded file.

url.title: Link
url.description: Where the document was found, copied exactly.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Site, journal or forum that published it.

year.title: Year
year.description: Publication year when the hit shows one, empty otherwise.

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: Short verbatim snippet showing the stakeholder voice in the document.

text.title: Text
text.description: The document text the search hit brought, copied verbatim; the miner extracts its evidence quotes from it.

relevance_reason.title: Why it matters
relevance_reason.description: Which stakeholder types or topics of the plan this document covers.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Where the document came from: a live-search hit or a member upload.
